contentPattern.structure: heading + toolbar(ondemand/upcoming toggle + event filter) + responsive card grid + popup video player

suitableFor: on-demand + upcoming content grids that open a popup player
filterable thumbnail grids with per-card speakers and event tagging
notSuitableFor: query-index driven tabular event lists (use event-list)
product category tiles with asset carousels (use products-solutions)

notes: NEW block created for the Innovation Theater migration. Not a variant of an existing block — no existing block modelled a session video grid with popup player + ondemand/upcoming filtering + per-card speakers. The Section 2 sticky OnDemand/Upcoming + event filter toolbar is folded into this block's toolbar.
